levels.title: Nx projects
levels.label: Nx 專案
levels.intro: Each node is an Nx project, labelled with its `type:*` tag. An arrow `a --> b` means project `a` depends on project `b` (from `nx graph`).

levels.title: Capture Runtime contexts
levels.label: Capture Runtime 上下文
levels.intro: Each node is a top-level group of the `capture_runtime` Python package. An arrow `a --> b` means a module in `a` imports a module in `b` (from grimp); imports inside one group are not drawn.

levels.title: UI modules
levels.label: UI 模組
levels.intro: Each node is a Sheriff module of the Angular UI package, the shell app, or the runtime client SDK, labelled with its Sheriff tags; `root` holds files outside every module. An arrow `a --> b` means a TypeScript file in `a` imports a file in `b`.
